M+ archival completed-building photo freshly downloaded and personally viewed; capture date unknown. Original 1986-1989 project interval and URL version date are not capture dates. Only original entry-corner segment, not full building or a real rear facade. New assignments extend the existing tan material onto full original front/return bay caps and return bay undersides, opaque dark green onto two original canopy-cut side returns, and stair grey onto original left/right step end faces. These hidden material continuations are inferences. All precolored triangles and all original RGBA/roughness preserved. Broad alternating white/tan wall and column bands cannot be represented with full original face boundaries, so broad walls, columns and thin relief courses stay neutral. Artificial closures, main roof, base, unresolved window reveals and rear stair closure stay neutral. No geometry edits, face splits, letters, tile motifs, bars, transparent roof or glazing across open colonnade.2016/2018 sources not freshly reread; no2026condition claim.
